1339-1531-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1531-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2511-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

728-1349-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
728-1349-4153.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Resourceful Defense's ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Resourceful Defense.
When Resourceful Defense dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Resourceful Defense from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 6.
Repeat.

791-4551-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-4551-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

618-2438-3305.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

225-1308-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2034-5003-7699.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Drone, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Drone dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dread Drone from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dread Drone enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-4742.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

1978-2593-4241.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Karn.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

465-3817-6798.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1456-1492-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1456-1492-4195-4574.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3755-4222.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

586-944-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4056-4679-4753--82.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator's toughness has been boosted by at least 1.
4056-4679-4753--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Clever Impersonator. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature. Then, untap Yenna and scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.
4056-4679-4753--82.notes: Because Clever Impersonator has base toughness of 0, you will need some way to keep it from dying. This can be done using anthem effects, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters, having Auras attached to it, etc. If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2468-3963-6587-6588.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor, triggering its ability, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

147-3967-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-1479-3875-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-3875-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

957-1987-4125-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4125-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

969-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
969-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

3391-3967-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2034-2584-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

4152-4231-5856.easyPrerequisites:
A creature has died this turn.
You control at least one Food.
4152-4231-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Undercity Scrounger's ability by tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token.
Repeat.

1379-1558-1908-2567.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
1379-1558-1908-2567.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Avenger of Zendikar with haste.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Avenger of Zendikar token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4111-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Headhunter, adding {B}.
When Headhunter dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Headhunter from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Headhunter's morph ability by paying {B}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

864-2034-2596-4465.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
864-2034-2596-4465.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

586-3045-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B} that can only be spent as though it were colorless mana due to Celestial Dawn.
Repeat.

460-539-3421.notablePrerequisites: Willow Priestess does not have summoning sickness.
460-539-3421.description:
Activate Willow Priestess' first ability by tapping it, putting Scryb Ranger from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning itself to your hand, untapping Willow Priestess.
Repeat.

1530-3293-5233.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-3293-5233.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Boros Garrison from your hand.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
